# StagePeek

> StagePeek (https://stagepeek.live) is an interactive 2D seating chart and 3D concert stage-view simulator covering 201 stadiums, indoor arenas, domes, and theatres across North America, the UK, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Australia. Concertgoers enter the section, row, and seat on their ticket—or click any stand section—to inspect stage orientation, elevation, End / Runway / 360° Center stage layouts, and 1×–10× smartphone telephoto camera framing before buying tickets.

Last reviewed: 2026-11-24

## Key Capabilities & Honest Data Precision Policy

- **201 Custom 3D Architectural Venue Models**: Every released venue includes an interactive 2D section map and a custom-built 3D architectural stand bowl with 1.18 m eye-level sightline framing and 1×–10× smartphone zoom simulation.
- **32 Exact Seat-Coordinate Venues**: Coordinate-backed row-and-seat matching from public seating records (including The O2 London, Kia Forum Los Angeles, United Center Chicago, UBS Arena New York, Prudential Center Newark, State Farm Arena Atlanta, Accor Arena Paris, Ziggo Dome Amsterdam, Uber Arena Berlin, Kai Tak Stadium, Hong Kong Coliseum, Taipei Arena, Taipei Dome, Tokyo Dome, Kyocera Dome, Singapore National Stadium, Rajamangala Stadium, Bukit Jalil National Stadium, and Philippine Arena).
- **Official Sampled-Seat & Section-Level 3D Sightlines**: Major North American and European stadiums/arenas provide verified section geometry and reference tier sightlines without fabricating unverified seat numbers.
- **536+ Listed 2026–2027 Concert Tour Dates Across 130 Flagship Venues**: Includes BTS (Arirang World Tour), Bruno Mars (The Romantic Tour), Harry Styles (Together, Together), Oasis (Live '27), Ed Sheeran (Loop Tour), Ariana Grande (The Eternal Sunshine Tour), Lady Gaga (The Mayhem Ball), Olivia Rodrigo, Noah Kahan, Luke Combs, Metallica (M72), Zach Bryan, U2, Stray Kids, BIGBANG, IU, Kenshi Yonezu, YOASOBI, Jay Chou, Jolin Tsai, Andy Lau, Silence Wang, and Phoenix Legend.
- **Strict Non-Deception Policy**: All 2D/3D renders, straight-line distances, and 1×–10× zoom frames are geometric simulations for ticket comparison—not live photographs or promoter CAD blueprints.

## Core Documentation & Multilingual Entry Points

- [StagePeek Home (English)](https://stagepeek.live/): Interactive 3D preview and product overview.
- [Global Venue Directory (201 Venues)](https://stagepeek.live/venues/): Filterable index of all 201 stadiums, arenas, and domes with section counts and 3D capabilities.
- [Complete 201-Venue LLM Reference (llms-full.txt)](https://stagepeek.live/llms-full.txt): Exhaustive venue-by-venue specifications, section numbering, precision tiers, and concert schedules.
- [How StagePeek Works & Sightline Methodology](https://stagepeek.live/methodology): Step-by-step guide to reading sections, stage presets, and 1×–10× zoom framing.
- [Free vs. StagePeek Pro Plans](https://stagepeek.live/plans): Free tier includes 2D maps, 3D arena overview rotation, and first 2 seat checks (1×–2× framing) per venue; Pro unlocks 3×–10× telephoto framing and unlimited seat comparisons.
- [简体中文入口 (Simplified Chinese)](https://stagepeek.live/zh-CN/): 演唱会 2D/3D 选座与舞台视角指南。
- [繁體中文入口 (Traditional Chinese)](https://stagepeek.live/zh-TW/): 演唱會座位表與 3D 舞台視角模擬。
- [日本語ガイド (Japanese)](https://stagepeek.live/ja/): 座席表・3Dステージ見え方ガイド。
- [한국어 가이드 (Korean)](https://stagepeek.live/ko/): 콘서트 좌석배치도 및 3D 시야 가이드。
